name: Morpho Purinta USDG vault

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths checked

narrative.summary: Real, distinct 3-of-5 Safes for curator and owner, with overlapping membership - one of the two best-separated Morpho vaults found on this chain.
narrative.detail: ~$50.4K TVL. No bare-EOA exposure at any traced hop. Still capped in the 30s because the setOwner/setCurator zero-delay gap is systemic across every Morpho vault checked on this chain, not something either vault’s own governance choices could fix.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
